correctness.rationale: For prime p with p ≡ 1 (mod 13), exact complete affine-orbit partition of 455 three-multisets and 1820 four-multisets reduces any possible vanishing sum to 5 and 16 representatives. Independent symbolic resultant computations match all 21 exact Bareiss determinants of multiplication in Z[X]/Φ13, and trial-division norms have eligible prime support {53,2731} and {53,79,131,157,1327,2003,7229,398581}. Splitting of Φ13 modulo p establishes the bidirectional correspondence with zero sums of q-powers; absence of -1 in odd-order H excludes lengths 1 and 2. Script explicitly checks witness sums at each exceptional p. No prime-range bound is used.

value.rationale: The minimum length of a zero sum of subgroup powers is a natural arithmetic invariant explicitly discussed in the 2022 motivating paper, which gives illustrative order-13 examples. The finding gives a complete cutoff classification across all admissible primes, rather than a bounded computation: exactly two primes have minimum three, seven have minimum four, and all others at least five. It adds five previously unlisted exceptional primes, gives a compact complete 21-orbit integral certificate, and is a useful natural classification step extending the analogous order-eleven project while remaining mathematically distinct. Does not claim a result for minimum at least five.
